title: Sending Your First Message
drDigitalIntro:
Now that you know how to find a contact, let's actually send a message.
• Click the message box at the bottom of the conversation — the cursor will appear there.
• Type what you want to say. You can take as long as you like — nothing sends until you press Enter.
• Press Enter or click the Send button and your message appears in the conversation.
• The other person sees it on their phone or computer almost instantly.

steps.say: Click on Alex — they sent you a question.
Alex asked: What's your favorite animal? Type your answer and send it.

drDigitalSuccess: Message sent, and Alex has it. There is no wrong thing to say here, so say whatever you like.
drDigitalHint: Click the message box at the bottom, type your answer to Alex's question, then press Enter or click the Send button.
